privacy.metaDescription: Momzy's privacy policy — how we collect and protect your data
privacy.label: Legal
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Momzy we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website momzyworld.com.

0.title: Information we collect
0.intro: When you make a purchase or contact us, we collect the following information:

items.3: Delivery address (town, street and house number)

0.note: We do not collect credit card details — payment is processed directly through the secure HYP payment gateway.

1.title: How we use your information
1.intro: We use your data solely for the following purposes:

items.1: Contacting you about your order or delivery status
items.2: Sending promotional messages if you have opted in (you can unsubscribe at any time)

2.title: Sharing data with third parties
2.intro: We do not sell your data to any third party. We share your information only with:

items.0: The shipping company — to deliver your order
items.1: The HYP payment gateway — to process payment securely
items.2: The email service — to send order confirmations

2.note: All third parties are bound to keep your data confidential in accordance with applicable laws.

3.title: Data security
3.body: We use the HTTPS protocol to encrypt all data transferred between your browser and our servers. Order data is stored in a secure database with restricted access permissions.

4.title: Cookies
4.body: We use cookies to save the contents of your shopping cart during your session. We do not use them to track you across other websites. You can disable them in your browser settings, though this may affect how the shopping cart works.

5.title: Your rights
5.intro: At any time you have the right to:

items.0: Request access to the data we hold about you
items.1: Request correction of any inaccurate data
items.2: Request deletion of your data (subject to legal requirements)

6.title: Data retention
6.body: We keep order data for 3 years for accounting and legal purposes. Mailing list data is deleted as soon as you unsubscribe.

7.title: Contact us
7.body: If you have any question about this privacy policy or your personal data, we'd be happy to hear from you through our <link>contact us</link> page.

terms.metaDescription: Momzy's terms and conditions — the rights and obligations of the user and the website
terms.label: Legal
terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By using the Momzy website or making a purchase, you agree to the terms and conditions set out on this page. Please read them carefully before continuing.

0.title: About the site
0.body: Momzy is a motherhood care platform founded by Heba Hasan — a certified nurse, lactation consultant and birth doula. The site offers physical and digital products and recorded workshops for moms in Israel.

items.0: Purchasing is available without registering an account — anonymously
items.1: Prices are in Israeli shekels ₪ and include VAT
items.2: Payment is processed through the secure HYP payment gateway
items.3: An order is considered confirmed once payment confirmation is received from HYP
items.4: We reserve the right to refuse any order in cases of suspected fraud

items.0: Shipping is available within Israel only
items.1: Estimated delivery time: up to 7 business days from order confirmation
items.2: Shipping fee: ₪40 for physical products — free for digital products
items.3: A tracking number is sent after your order ships
items.4: The site is not responsible for any delays on the part of the shipping company

physicalItems.0: You have the right to request a return within 14 days of receiving your order
physicalItems.1: The product must be unused and in its original packaging
physicalItems.2: Return costs are borne by the customer, except in the case of defects

digitalItems.0: Returns are not possible after the file has been downloaded or the workshop viewed
digitalItems.1: In the event of a technical issue, we are committed to finding an alternative solution

4.title: Digital content rights
4.intro: All digital products (the booklets and recorded workshops) are the exclusive intellectual property of Heba Hasan.

items.0: Publishing, distributing or sharing the content with any other party is strictly prohibited
items.1: Reselling the content or using it for commercial purposes is prohibited
items.2: Download links are valid for 7 days and up to 5 downloads maximum
items.3: Use is limited to personal purposes only

4.note: Any violation of these rights exposes the offender to legal liability.

5.title: Disclaimer
5.body: The information provided on the site and in the products is of an awareness and educational nature and is not a substitute for consulting a doctor or health professional. Momzy is not responsible for any consequences arising from applying the information provided without consulting a specialist.

6.title: Changes to the terms
6.body: We reserve the right to amend these terms at any time. The date of the last update will be published at the top of the page. Your continued use of the site after an update constitutes your acceptance of the new terms.

7.title: Governing law
7.body: These terms and conditions are subject to the laws of the State of Israel. Any dispute will be resolved before the competent courts in Israel.

8.title: Contact us
8.body: For any question about these terms, contact us through our <link>contact us</link> page.
